  computed: {
    /** Project the git view works with: explicit panel param, else active project */
    project() {
      return this.params?.project || this.$storex.projects.activeProject || null
    },
    projectName() {
      return this.project?.project_name || 'No project'
    },
    projectPath() {
      return this.project?.abs_project_path || this.project?.codx_path || ''
    },
    api() {
      return this.project?.$api || null
    },
    isGit() {
      return !!(this.info?.active_branch || this.branches.length)
    },
    currentBranch() {
      return this.info?.active_branch || this.branches[0] || null
    },
    filteredBranches() {
      const filter = this.branchFilter.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!filter) return this.branches
      return this.branches.filter(b => b.toLowerCase().includes(filter))
    },
    selectedTree() {
      return this.repoTree.find(b => this.sameBranch(b.branch_name, this.selectedBranch)) || null
    },
    commits() {
      if (this.selectedTree?.commits?.length) {
        return this.selectedTree.commits.map(c => this.normalizeCommit({
          commit: c.commit_id,
          author: c.author,
          date: c.date,
          message: c.comment
        }))
      }
      return this.rawCommits
    },
    /** Working tree files split into staged / not staged */
    statusFiles() {
      const info = this.info || {}

      // Preferred source: structured lists from the API
      if (Array.isArray(info.staged) || Array.isArray(info.unstaged)) {
        return {
          staged: (info.staged || [])
            .map(file => this.buildStatusFile(this.codeFor(file), file.path || file.file_name))
            .filter(Boolean),
          unstaged: (info.unstaged || [])
            .map(file => this.buildStatusFile(this.codeFor(file), file.path || file.file_name))
            .filter(Boolean)
        }
      }

      // Fallback: derive both lists from `git status --porcelain` lines
      const staged = []
      const unstaged = []
      const lines = info.changed_files || []
      lines.forEach(line => {
        const parsed = this.parsePorcelainLine(line)
        if (!parsed) return
        if (parsed.index === '?' && parsed.worktree === '?') {
          const file = this.buildStatusFile('?', parsed.path)
          if (file) unstaged.push(file)
          return
        }
        if (parsed.index !== ' ') {
          const file = this.buildStatusFile(parsed.index, parsed.path)
          if (file) staged.push(file)
        }
        if (parsed.worktree !== ' ' && parsed.worktree !== '?') {
          const file = this.buildStatusFile(parsed.worktree, parsed.path)
          if (file) unstaged.push(file)
        }
      })
      return { staged, unstaged }
    },
    stagedFiles() {
      return this.statusFiles.staged
    },
    unstagedFiles() {
      return this.statusFiles.unstaged
    },
    workingTreeCount() {
      return this.stagedFiles.length + this.unstagedFiles.length
    },
    workingTreeGroups() {
      return [
        { key: 'staged', label: 'Staged', empty: 'No staged changes', files: this.stagedFiles },
        { key: 'changes', label: 'Changes', empty: 'No unstaged changes', files: this.unstagedFiles }
      ]
    },
    stagedSelection() {
      return this.selectedPaths('staged')
    },
    changesSelection() {
      return this.selectedPaths('changes')
    },
    selectionCount() {
      return this.stagedSelection.length + this.changesSelection.length
    },
    commitHint() {
      if (this.stagedFiles.length) {
        return `${this.stagedFiles.length} staged file(s) will be committed`
      }
      if (this.unstagedFiles.length) {
        return 'Nothing staged: every change will be staged and committed'
      }
      return 'No changes to commit'
    },
    canCommit() {
      return !!this.commitMessage.trim() && this.workingTreeCount > 0
    },
    /** Identity of the open diff: remounts the pane for every file / group */
    diffKey() {
      if (!this.selectedFile) return null
      return `${this.selectedFile.group}:${this.selectedFile.path}`
    }
  },
  created() {
    this.loadRepo()
  },
  methods: {
    sameBranch(a, b) {
      const clean = value => (value || '').replace(/^[*+\s]+/, '').trim()
      return !!a && !!b && clean(a) === clean(b)
    },

    normalizeCommit(commit) {
      const id = commit.commit || commit.commit_id || commit.hash || ''
      const author = typeof commit.author === 'object'
        ? (commit.author?.name || '')
        : (commit.author || '')
      return {
        id,
        short: commit.short_commit || (id || '').slice(0, 8),
        author,
        date: commit.date || '',
        message: commit.message || commit.comment || '',
        relative: commit.date ? this.relativeDate(commit.date) : ''
      }
    },

    relativeDate(date) {
      const m = moment(date)
      return m.isValid() ? m.fromNow() : date
    },

    branchCommitCount(branch) {
      const tree = this.repoTree.find(b => this.sameBranch(b.branch_name, branch))
      return tree?.commits?.length || 0
    },

    // ── Working tree ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    /** Split a porcelain line (`XY <path>`) into index/worktree codes and path */
    parsePorcelainLine(line) {
      if (!line || !line.trim()) return null
      let index = ' '
      let worktree = ' '
      let path = ''
      if (line.length >= 3 && line[2] === ' ') {
        index = line[0]
        worktree = line[1]
        path = line.slice(3)
      } else if (line.length >= 2) {
        // Leading space trimmed by the transport: only the worktree code is left
        worktree = line[0]
        path = line.slice(2)
      } else {
        return null
      }
      path = this.cleanStatusPath(path)
      return path ? { index, worktree, path } : null
    },

    cleanStatusPath(path) {
      let value = (path || '').trim()
      if (value.includes(' -> ')) value = value.split(' -> ').pop()
      return value.replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim()
    },

    statusMeta(code) {
      const meta = {
        A: { label: 'Added', icon: 'fa-circle-plus', color: 'text-success' },
        M: { label: 'Modified', icon: 'fa-pen', color: 'text-warning' },
        D: { label: 'Deleted', icon: 'fa-trash-can', color: 'text-error' },
        R: { label: 'Renamed', icon: 'fa-arrow-right-arrow-left', color: 'text-info' },
        C: { label: 'Copied', icon: 'fa-copy', color: 'text-info' },
        T: { label: 'Type changed', icon: 'fa-shuffle', color: 'text-warning' },
        U: { label: 'Conflict', icon: 'fa-triangle-exclamation', color: 'text-error' },
        '?': { label: 'Untracked', icon: 'fa-file-circle-plus', color: 'text-success' }
      }
      return meta[(code || '').trim()] || meta.M
    },

    /** Status code for an API entry, which can expose a code or a status name */
    codeFor(file) {
      if (file?.code) return file.code
      const codes = {
        added: 'A',
        modified: 'M',
        deleted: 'D',
        renamed: 'R',
        copied: 'C',
        typechange: 'T',
        conflict: 'U',
        untracked: '?'
      }
      return codes[(file?.status || '').toLowerCase()] || 'M'
    },

    buildStatusFile(code, path) {
      const clean = this.cleanStatusPath(path)
      if (!clean) return null
      const normalized = (code || '').trim() || 'M'
      const meta = this.statusMeta(normalized)
      return {
        path: clean,
        code: normalized,
        icon: meta.icon,
        color: meta.color,
        label: meta.label
      }
    },

    fileName(path) {
      return (path || '').split('/').pop()
    },

    fileDir(path) {
      const parts = (path || '').split('/')
      parts.pop()
      return parts.join('/')
    },

    isSectionCollapsed(key) {
      return !!this.collapsedSections[key]
    },

    toggleSection(key) {
      this.collapsedSections = {
        ...this.collapsedSections,
        [key]: !this.collapsedSections[key]
      }
    },

    // ── Multi selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    fileKey(group, path) {
      return `${group}:${path}`
    },

    isSelected(group, path) {
      return !!this.selection[this.fileKey(group, path)]
    },

    /** Index of a file inside its group, -1 when it is not there anymore */
    fileIndex(group, path) {
      return this.groupFiles(group).findIndex(file => file.path === path)
    },

    /** Replace the whole selection with the given keys */
    setSelection(keys) {
      const next = {}
      ;(keys || []).forEach(key => { next[key] = true })
      this.selection = next
    },

    toggleSelect(group, path) {
      const key = this.fileKey(group, path)
      const next = { ...this.selection }
      if (next[key]) {
        delete next[key]
      } else {
        next[key] = true
      }
      this.selection = next
    },

    /**
     * Shift+click: select every file between the anchor and the clicked file.
     * Without a valid anchor in the same group it falls back to a single
     * selection.
     */
    selectRange(group, path) {
      const targetIndex = this.fileIndex(group, path)
      if (targetIndex < 0) return

      const anchor = this.selectionAnchor
      const anchorIndex = anchor && anchor.group === group
        ? this.fileIndex(group, anchor.path)
        : -1

      if (anchorIndex < 0) {
        this.setSelection([this.fileKey(group, path)])
        this.selectionAnchor = { group, path }
        return
      }

      const [start, end] = anchorIndex <= targetIndex
        ? [anchorIndex, targetIndex]
        : [targetIndex, anchorIndex]

      const files = this.groupFiles(group).slice(start, end + 1)
      this.setSelection(files.map(file => this.fileKey(group, file.path)))
    },

    /** Row click: plain = single selection + diff, ctrl = toggle, shift = range */
    onRowClick(event, group, file) {
      if (!file?.path) return

      if (event?.shiftKey) {
        this.selectRange(group, file.path)
        return
      }

      if (event?.ctrlKey || event?.metaKey) {
        this.toggleSelect(group, file.path)
      } else {
        this.setSelection([this.fileKey(group, file.path)])
      }

      this.selectionAnchor = { group, path: file.path }
      this.openDiff(group, file)
    },

    /** Checkbox click: plain = toggle, shift = select the range */
    onCheckboxClick(event, group, file) {
      if (!file?.path) return

      if (event?.shiftKey) {
        this.selectRange(group, file.path)
        return
      }

      this.toggleSelect(group, file.path)
      this.selectionAnchor = { group, path: file.path }
    },

    /** Paths of the current selection belonging to a group */
    selectedPaths(group) {
      const prefix = `${group}:`
      return Object.keys(this.selection)
        .filter(key => this.selection[key] && key.startsWith(prefix))
        .map(key => key.slice(prefix.length))
    },

    groupFiles(group) {
      return group === 'staged' ? this.stagedFiles : this.unstagedFiles
    },

    groupAllSelected(group) {
      const files = this.groupFiles(group)
      return files.length > 0 && files.every(file => this.isSelected(group, file.path))
    },

    toggleGroupSelection(group) {
      const files = this.groupFiles(group)
      const allSelected = this.groupAllSelected(group)
      const next = { ...this.selection }
      files.forEach(file => {
        const key = this.fileKey(group, file.path)
        if (allSelected) {
          delete next[key]
        } else {
          next[key] = true
        }
      })
      this.selection = next
    },

    clearSelection() {
      this.selection = {}
      this.selectionAnchor = null
    },

    /** Drop selections (and the anchor) whose file left its group */
    pruneSelection() {
      const valid = new Set()
      this.stagedFiles.forEach(file => valid.add(this.fileKey('staged', file.path)))
      this.unstagedFiles.forEach(file => valid.add(this.fileKey('changes', file.path)))
      const next = {}
      Object.keys(this.selection).forEach(key => {
        if (this.selection[key] && valid.has(key)) next[key] = true
      })
      this.selection = next

      if (this.selectionAnchor) {
        const anchorKey = this.fileKey(this.selectionAnchor.group, this.selectionAnchor.path)
        if (!valid.has(anchorKey)) this.selectionAnchor = null
      }
    },

    isFileOpen(group, path) {
      return this.selectedFile?.group === group && this.selectedFile?.path === path
    },

    openDiff(group, file) {
      if (!file?.path) return
      // Same file/group already open: keep it (no remount, no extra request)
      if (this.isFileOpen(group, file.path)) return
      this.selectedFile = {
        path: file.path,
        group,
        code: file.code,
        icon: file.icon,
        color: file.color,
        label: file.label
      }
    },

    closeDiff() {
      this.selectedFile = null
    },

    /** Keep the diff pane in sync with the reloaded working tree */
    syncSelectedFile() {
      if (!this.selectedFile) return

      const { path, group } = this.selectedFile
      const order = group === 'staged'
        ? ['staged', 'changes']
        : ['changes', 'staged']

      for (const key of order) {
        const match = this.groupFiles(key).find(file => file.path === path)
        if (match) {
          this.selectedFile = {
            path: match.path,
            group: key,
            code: match.code,
            icon: match.icon,
            color: match.color,
            label: match.label
          }
          return
        }
      }

      // The file is no longer part of the working tree (committed or rolled back)
      this.selectedFile = null
    },

    onFileChanged() {
      return this.loadRepo()
    },

    // ── Graph ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    onSelectCommit(commit) {
      this.selectedCommit = commit
    },

    closeCommit() {
      this.selectedCommit = null
    },

    /**
     * Branch action requested from the commit panel (which only lists the refs
     * pointing to the selected commit): checkout, merge into the current
     * branch, rebase the current branch onto it, or delete the branch.
     */
    async onCommitBranchAction({ action, branch } = {}) {
      if (!branch || !this.api) return

      if (action === 'checkout') {
        return this.onCheckout(branch)
      }

      if (action === 'delete') {
        await this.deleteBranch(branch)
        this.selectedCommit = null
        return
      }

      const target = this.currentBranch
      if (!target) {
        this.error = 'No branch is checked out'
        return
      }
      if (this.sameBranch(branch, target)) {
        this.error = `"${branch}" is already the current branch`
        return
      }

      if (action === 'merge') {
        if (!window.confirm(`Merge "${branch}" into "${target}"?`)) return
        await this.runOperation(
          () => this.api.repo.merge({ from_branch: branch, to_branch: target }),
          `Merged ${branch} into ${target}`
        )
        this.selectedCommit = null
        return
      }

      if (action === 'rebase') {
        if (!window.confirm(
          `Rebase "${target}" onto "${branch}"? This rewrites the commits of "${target}".`
        )) return
        await this.runOperation(
          () => this.api.repo.rebase({ onto_branch: branch, branch: target }),
          `Rebased ${target} onto ${branch}`
        )
        this.selectedCommit = null
      }
    },

    // ── Working tree operations ─────────────────────────────────────────
    async stagePaths(paths) {
      const list = paths || []
      if (!list.length || !this.api) return
      await this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.stage(list),
        `${list.length} file(s) staged`
      )
      this.clearSelection()
    },

    async unstagePaths(paths) {
      const list = paths || []
      if (!list.length || !this.api) return
      await this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.unstage(list),
        `${list.length} file(s) unstaged`
      )
      this.clearSelection()
    },

    async discardPaths(paths) {
      const list = paths || []
      if (!list.length || !this.api) return
      const label = list.length === 1 ? `"${list[0]}"` : `${list.length} files`
      if (!window.confirm(`Roll back ${label} to the last commit? This cannot be undone.`)) return
      await this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.discard(list, true),
        `${list.length} file(s) rolled back`
      )
      this.clearSelection()
    },

    // ── Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async loadRepo() {
      if (!this.api) return
      this.loading = true
      this.error = null
      try {
        const [info, branchesRes] = await Promise.all([
          this.api.repo.info().catch(() => ({})),
          this.api.repo.branches()
        ])
        this.info = info || {}
        this.branches = Array.isArray(branchesRes) ? branchesRes : (branchesRes?.branches || [])
        this.repoTree = branchesRes?.repo_tree || []

        if (!this.selectedBranch || !this.branches.includes(this.selectedBranch)) {
          this.selectedBranch = this.currentBranch || this.branches[0] || null
        }
        this.pruneSelection()
        this.syncSelectedFile()
        await this.loadCommitsForBranch(this.selectedBranch)
      } catch (ex) {
        this.error = `Unable to load repository: ${ex?.message || ex}`
      } finally {
        this.loading = false
      }
    },

    selectBranch(branch) {
      if (!branch) return
      this.selectedBranch = branch
      this.rawCommits = []
      this.loadCommitsForBranch(branch)
    },

    async loadCommitsForBranch(branch) {
      if (!this.api || !branch) return
      const tree = this.repoTree.find(b => this.sameBranch(b.branch_name, branch))
      if (tree?.commits?.length) {
        this.rawCommits = []
        return
      }
      this.commitsLoading = true
      try {
        const res = await this.api.repo.commits(branch)
        this.rawCommits = this.parseRawCommits(res)
      } catch {
        this.rawCommits = []
      } finally {
        this.commitsLoading = false
      }
    },

    /** Fallback parser for `git log` output when repo_tree is not available */
    parseRawCommits(res) {
      const raw = res?.commits ?? res
      if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw.map(c => this.normalizeCommit(c))
      if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw.trim()) return []
      return raw.split(/^commit /m).filter(Boolean).map(block => {
        const lines = block.split('\n')
        const id = lines[0].trim().split(' ')[0]
        const authorLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('Author:')) || ''
        const dateLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('Date:')) || ''
        const blankIndex = lines.findIndex(l => l.trim() === '')
        const message = (blankIndex > -1 ? lines.slice(blankIndex + 1).join(' ') : '').trim()
        return this.normalizeCommit({
          commit: id,
          author: authorLine.replace('Author:', '').trim(),
          date: dateLine.replace('Date:', '').trim(),
          message
        })
      })
    },

    // ── Shared operation runner ─────────────────────────────────────────
    async runOperation(fn, successMessage) {
      if (!this.api) return
      this.error = null
      this.notice = null
      this.busy = true
      try {
        await fn()
        if (successMessage) this.notice = successMessage
        await this.loadRepo()
        // Branches, hashes and lanes changed: reload the graph too
        this.graphRefreshToken += 1
      } catch (ex) {
        this.error = ex?.response?.data?.detail || ex?.message || String(ex)
      } finally {
        this.busy = false
      }
    },

    // ── Remote operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    onFetch() {
      this.runOperation(() => this.api.repo.fetch(), 'Fetched from remote')
    },
    onPull() {
      this.runOperation(() => this.api.repo.pull(), 'Pulled from remote')
    },
    onPush() {
      this.runOperation(() => this.api.repo.push(), 'Pushed to remote')
    },

    // ── Branch operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    onCheckout(branch) {
      if (!branch || this.sameBranch(branch, this.currentBranch)) return
      this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.checkoutBranch(branch),
        `Checked out ${branch}`
      )
    },

    toggleNewBranch() {
      this.showNewBranch = !this.showNewBranch
      this.newBranchName = ''
      this.newBranchFrom = this.selectedBranch || this.currentBranch || ''
    },

    async createBranch() {
      const name = this.newBranchName.trim()
      if (!name || !this.api) return
      await this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.createBranch({
          branch: name,
          from_branch: this.newBranchFrom || this.currentBranch
        }),
        `Branch ${name} created`
      )
      this.showNewBranch = false
      this.selectedBranch = name
      this.loadCommitsForBranch(name)
    },

    async deleteBranch(branch) {
      if (!branch || !this.api) return
      if (!window.confirm(`Delete branch "${branch}"?`)) return
      await this.runOperation(
        () => this.api.repo.deleteBranch(branch),
        `Branch ${branch} deleted`
      )
    },

    // ── Commit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async doCommit() {
      const message = this.commitMessage.trim()
      if (!message || !this.api || this.committing || !this.workingTreeCount) return
      // Commit what is staged; stage everything only when nothing is staged
      const stageAll = this.stagedFiles.length === 0
      this.committing = true
      this.error = null
      this.notice = null
      try {
        await this.api.repo.commit({ message, stage_all: stageAll })
        this.notice = 'Changes committed'
        this.commitMessage = ''
        this.clearSelection()
        await this.loadRepo()
        this.graphRefreshToken += 1
      } catch (ex) {
        this.error = ex?.response?.data?.detail || ex?.message || String(ex)
      } finally {
        this.committing = false
      }
    },

    // ── Merge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    openMerge() {
      this.mergeFrom = this.selectedBranch || this.currentBranch || ''
      this.mergeTo = this.currentBranch || this.branches[0] || ''
      this.mergeMessage = ''
      this.mergePreview = null
      this.showMerge = true
      this.loadMergePreview()
    },

    async loadMergePreview() {
      if (!this.api || !this.mergeFrom || !this.mergeTo) return
      this.mergePreviewLoading = true
      this.mergePreview = null
      try {
        const changes = await this.api.repo.changes({
          from_branch: this.mergeFrom,
          to_branch: this.mergeTo
        })
        const files = Object.keys(changes?.branch_file_and_commits || {})
        this.mergePreview = {
          fileCount: files.length,
          files: files.slice(0, 25),
          stat: changes?.stat || ''
        }
      } catch {
        this.mergePreview = null
      } finally {
        this.mergePreviewLoading = false
      }
    },

    async doMerge() {
      if (!this.mergeFrom || !this.mergeTo || !this.api) return
      if (this.sameBranch(this.mergeFrom, this.mergeTo)) {
        this.error = 'Source and target branches must be different'
        return
      }
      this.merging = true
      this.error = null
      try {
        await this.api.repo.merge({
          from_branch: this.mergeFrom,
          to_branch: this.mergeTo,
          message: this.mergeMessage.trim() || undefined
        })
        this.notice = `Merged ${this.mergeFrom} into ${this.mergeTo}`
        this.showMerge = false
        await this.loadRepo()
        this.graphRefreshToken += 1
      } catch (ex) {
        this.error = ex?.response?.data?.detail || ex?.message || String(ex)
      } finally {
        this.merging = false
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="git-view h-full w-full flex flex-col bg-base-100 overflow-hidden">
    <!-- ── Toolbar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
    <header class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-base-200 border-b border-base-content/10 shrink-0 flex-wrap">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-folder-tree text-warning"></i>
      <span class="font-mono text-sm font-semibold truncate min-w-0" :title="projectPath">{{ projectName }}</span>
      <span v-if="currentBranch" class="badge badge-sm badge-primary badge-outline gap-1" title="Current branch">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-check text-[9px]"></i> {{ currentBranch }}
      </span>

      <div class="grow"></div>

      <div v-if="isGit" class="join">
        <button class="join-item btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="onFetch" :disabled="busy" title="Fetch from remote">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-down"></i>
        </button>
        <button class="join-item btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="onPull" :disabled="busy" title="Pull from remote">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down"></i>
        </button>
        <button class="join-item btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="onPush" :disabled="busy" title="Push to remote">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      <button class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="loadRepo" :disabled="loading" title="Reload repository">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right" :class="{ 'animate-spin': loading }"></i>
      </button>

      <div class="join">
        <button
          class="join-item btn btn-xs"
          :class="activeTab === 'repository' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'"
          @click="activeTab = 'repository'"
          title="Working tree, branches and commits"
        >
          <i class="fa-solid fa-code-branch"></i> Repository
        </button>
        <button
          class="join-item btn btn-xs"
          :class="activeTab === 'graph' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'"
          @click="activeTab = 'graph'"
          title="Commit graph of every branch"
        >
          <i class="fa-solid fa-diagram-project"></i> Graph
        </button>
        <button
          class="join-item btn btn-xs"
          :class="activeTab === 'review' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'"
          @click="activeTab = 'review'"
          title="Compare branches and review diffs"
        >
          <i class="fa-solid fa-code-compare"></i> Review
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- ── Feedback ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div v-if="error" class="alert alert-error rounded-none py-1 px-3 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
      <span class="grow">{{ error }}</span>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-xs" @click="error = null" aria-label="Dismiss error">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div v-if="notice" class="alert alert-success rounded-none py-1 px-3 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>
      <span class="grow">{{ notice }}</span>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-xs" @click="notice = null" aria-label="Dismiss notice">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- ── No project ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div v-if="!project" class="grow flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-base-content/40">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-code-branch text-4xl"></i>
      <span class="text-sm">No project selected</span>
    </div>

    <template v-else>
      <!-- ── Review: ChangesPanel (pick two branches, review diffs) ──────── -->
      <!-- v-show keeps the panel mounted so the branch selection survives tab switching -->
      <ChangesPanel
        v-show="activeTab === 'review'"
        :project="project"
        class="grow min-h-0 overflow-hidden"
      />

      <!-- ── Graph: commit graph + commit details ────────────────────────── -->
      <div v-show="activeTab === 'graph'" class="grow flex overflow-hidden">
        <GitGraph
          v-if="api"
          :api="api"
          :branches="branches"
          :current-branch="currentBranch || ''"
          :default-branch="info.default_branch || ''"
          :refresh-token="graphRefreshToken"
          class="grow min-w-0"
          @select-commit="onSelectCommit"
        />
        <div v-else class="grow flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-base-content/40">
          No project API available
        </div>

        <CommitDetail
          v-if="selectedCommit && api"
          :key="selectedCommit.hash"
          :api="api"
          :commit="selectedCommit"
          :current-branch="currentBranch || ''"
          :busy="busy"
          class="w-full md:w-[46%] md:max-w-[720px] shrink-0 border-l border-base-content/10"
          @close="closeCommit"
          @branch-action="onCommitBranchAction"
        />
      </div>

      <!-- ── Repository: working tree + branches + diff/commits ─────────── -->
      <div v-show="activeTab === 'repository'" class="grow flex overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Branches sidebar -->
        <aside class="hidden lg:flex lg:w-52 shrink-0 border-r border-base-content/10 flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 border-b border-base-content/10 shrink-0">
            <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50 grow">Branches</span>
            <button class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="toggleNewBranch" title="New branch" aria-label="New branch">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[10px]"></i>
            </button>
          </div>

          <!-- New branch form -->
          <div v-if="showNewBranch" class="p-2 border-b border-base-content/10 flex flex-col gap-1 shrink-0">
            <input
              v-model="newBranchName"
              type="text"
              placeholder="new-branch-name"
              class="input input-xs input-bordered w-full"
              @keyup.enter="createBranch"
              @keyup.esc="showNewBranch = false"
            />
            <select v-model="newBranchFrom" class="select select-xs select-bordered w-full" title="Branch from">
              <option v-for="b in branches" :key="`from-${b}`" :value="b">{{ b }}</option>
            </select>
            <div class="flex gap-1 justify-end">
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost" @click="showNewBranch = false">Cancel</button>
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-primary" :disabled="!newBranchName.trim() || busy" @click="createBranch">Create</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="px-2 py-1.5 border-b border-base-content/10 shrink-0">
            <input v-model="branchFilter" type="text" placeholder="Filter branches..." class="input input-xs input-bordered w-full" />
          </div>

          <div class="grow overflow-y-auto">
            <div v-if="loading && !branches.length" class="p-3 text-xs opacity-50">Loading branches...</div>
            <div v-else-if="!filteredBranches.length" class="p-3 text-xs opacity-50">No branches</div>
            <button
              v-for="branch in filteredBranches"
              :key="branch"
              class="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs transition-colors"
              :class="[
                selectedBranch === branch ? 'bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'hover:bg-base-200',
                sameBranch(branch, currentBranch) ? 'font-semibold' : ''
              ]"
              @click="selectBranch(branch)"
            >
              <i
                class="fa-solid"
                :class="sameBranch(branch, currentBranch) ? 'fa-circle-check text-success' : 'fa-code-branch opacity-50'"
              ></i>
              <span class="truncate grow" :title="branch">{{ branch }}</span>
              <span v-if="branchCommitCount(branch)" class="badge badge-xs badge-ghost">{{ branchCommitCount(branch) }}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <!-- Working tree -->
        <section class="w-full md:w-80 shrink-0 border-r border-base-content/10 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 border-b border-base-content/10 shrink-0">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-file-pen text-warning text-xs"></i>
            <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50 grow">Working tree</span>
            <span
              class="badge badge-xs"
              :class="workingTreeCount ? 'badge-warning badge-outline' : 'badge-ghost'"
              :title="`${workingTreeCount} changed file(s)`"
            >{{ workingTreeCount }}</span>
            <button
              class="btn btn-xs btn-ghost"
              @click="loadRepo"

| File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `api/codx/junior/engine/git_graph.py` | Modify | `rebase_branch`, `_resolve_onto_ref` | New rebase operation: resolves the onto ref (local → `origin/<branch>`), stashes local changes, checks out the branch, runs `git rebase`, aborts on conflicts and reports them, restores the stash. Reports `up_to_date` by comparing HEAD before/after |
| `api/codx/junior/api/git.py` | Modify | `RebaseRequest`, `POST /git/repo/rebase` | New endpoint backing the graph's "rebase current onto this branch" action |
| `client/src/api/models/gitGraph.js` | Modify | mock section removed, `normalizeGraphPayload` | Mock dataset and generators deleted; refs are now read from `payload.branches` (the shape the backend returns), so branch/tag badges attach to the right commits |
| `client/src/api/modules/repo.js` | Modify | `graph`, `commitDetail`, `remotes`, `worktrees`, `rebase` | Mock fallbacks and the derived-graph path deleted: real endpoints only, plus `commitDetail({ hash })` → `/api/git/repo/commit/detail` (fixes the empty file list / 422 on root commits) and the new `rebase()` |
| `client/src/components/repo/CommitDetail.vue` | Modify | refs section, `branch-action`, diff header | Mock banner removed; branch refs of the selected commit listed with Checkout / Merge into current / Rebase current onto this / Delete (disabled on the current branch); each file shows the diff against its first parent, with a `file vs <parent>` label |
| `client/src/components/repo/GitGraph.vue` | Modify | toolbar, watchers | `mock`/`derived` badges replaced by a commit counter; reloads on `include_remote` toggle, on branch change and on `refreshToken` |
| `client/src/components/repo/GitView.vue` | Modify | graph tab wiring | `graphRefreshToken` bumped after every operation, `onCommitBranchAction` dispatches checkout/merge/rebase/delete (with confirmations), `busy`/`currentBranch` passed to the commit panel |

### Notes

- **Why the file list was empty/broken**: `repo.commitDetail()` called `/commit/changes?from_commit=<hash>` without `to_commit` for root commits (422) and relied on 4 git commands per file. It now uses the single-call `/api/git/repo/commit/detail`, which diffs against the **first parent** (i.e. "previous version"), so clicking a file always shows the change introduced by that commit.
- **Delete on the checked-out branch stays disabled** (`git branch -D` would fail): the tooltip tells the user to check out another branch first. Merge/rebase are also disabled for the current branch since they are no-ops there.
- **Rebase is destructive** (rewrites hashes of the rebased branch), so it asks for confirmation and the backend always `git rebase --abort`s on conflict — the repo is never left mid-rebase.
- The engine picks up `DEFAULT_REMOTE` for resolving `origin/<branch>`, so rebasing onto a branch that only exists on the remote works without a local checkout.

"""
Commit graph and repository inspection engine for codx-junior.

Extends :class:`codx.junior.engine.git_workspace.GitWorkspaceEngine` with the
read operations the repository graph view needs:

- :meth:`GitGraphEngine.get_repo_graph`: commits (newest first) with their
  parents and refs, ready to be laid out as a VSCode *Git Graph* style graph.
- :meth:`GitGraphEngine.get_commit_detail`: changed files and patches of a
  single commit, read with a single ``git diff``.
- :meth:`GitGraphEngine.list_remotes`: configured remotes.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GGE[GitGraphEngine]
    GGE --> get_repo_graph
    GGE --> get_commit_detail
    GGE --> list_remotes
    GGE --> _graph_refs
    GGE --> _split_patches

    get_repo_graph --> _graph_refs
    _graph_refs --> for_each_ref
    get_repo_graph --> git_log
    get_commit_detail --> git_diff
    get_commit_detail --> _split_patches
```

Being a :class:`GitWorkspaceEngine`, it also serves every other endpoint of the
git router (branches, working tree, commits, merge, PR lifecycle).

Made with ❤️ by codx-junior
"""

import logging
import re

from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from codx.junior.engine.git_workspace import GitWorkspaceEngine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# First line of a per-file patch: used to split a full patch into its files
PATCH_SPLIT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?m)^(?=diff --git )")

# ``diff --git a/<old> b/<new>`` header of a single file patch
DIFF_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"^diff --git a/(?P<old>.+) b/(?P<new>.+)$", re.MULTILINE
)

# One commit per line: hash, parents, author name, author email, date, subject
COMMIT_FORMAT = "%H|%P|%an|%ae|%ad|%s"

# One ref per line: ref name, target object, peeled object (annotated tags)
REF_FORMAT = "%(refname)|%(objectname)|%(*objectname)"

DEFAULT_GRAPH_LIMIT = 150
MAX_GRAPH_LIMIT = 1000


class GitGraphEngine(GitWorkspaceEngine):
    """
    Read engine for the repository graph: commits, refs and commit details.

    ```mermaid
    sequenceDiagram
        participant UI as GitGraph.vue
        participant API as git router
        participant Engine as GitGraphEngine
        participant Git as git CLI

        UI->>API: GET /api/git/repo/graph?limit=150
        API->>Engine: get_repo_graph(limit=150)
        Engine->>Git: git for-each-ref refs/heads refs/tags refs/remotes
        Engine->>Git: git log --date-order -n 150 (--branches --tags --remotes)
        Engine-->>API: { commits, branches, default_branch, active_branch }
        API-->>UI: 200 graph payload

        UI->>API: GET /api/git/repo/commit/detail?commit=<sha>
        API->>Engine: get_commit_detail(commit)
        Engine->>Git: git show -s --format=...
        Engine->>Git: git diff <first-parent> <commit>
        Engine-->>API: { commit, stat, files: [{ path, diff, ... }] }
        API-->>UI: 200 commit detail
    ```
    """

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Remotes
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def list_remotes(self) -> List[dict]:
        """
        Return the configured git remotes.

        ``git remote -v`` prints one line per (remote, url, kind) tuple, so the
        lines are grouped by remote name into a single entry.

        Returns:
            List of dicts with 'name', 'url', 'fetch_url' and 'push_url'.

        Example:
            >>> engine.list_remotes()
            [{'name': 'origin', 'url': 'git@github.com:acme/app.git',
              'fetch_url': 'git@github.com:acme/app.git',
              'push_url': 'git@github.com:acme/app.git'}]
        """
        result = self._run_git(["remote", "-v"])
        if not result["ok"]:
            return []

    def _sanitize_branch_name(self, branch: str) -> str:
        """
        Sanitize branch name by removing prefixes like '* ' or '+ worktree/'.
        Keeps the last part after splitting by space.
        
        Args:
            branch: Raw branch name that may contain prefixes.
            
        Returns:
            Cleaned branch name.
        """
        if not branch:
            return branch
        
        # Remove common git branch prefixes
        cleaned = branch.lstrip("* +").strip()
        
        # If there's still a space, take the last part (handles "worktree/branch" cases)
        if " " in cleaned:
            cleaned = cleaned.split()[-1]
        
        return cleaned

    def _get_repo_root(self) -> str:
        """
        Return the git root path for the project, falling back to the project path.

        Returns:
            Absolute path of the repository root.
        """
        return self.find_git_root_path() or self.settings.abs_project_path

    def _run_git(
        self,
        args: List[str],
        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
        strip_output: bool = True,
    ) -> dict:
        """
        Run a git command without a shell and return a structured result.

        Uses ``subprocess.run`` with an argument list so branch names and file
        paths never need shell quoting, and stdout/stderr stay separated (unlike
        ``exec_command``, which merges stderr into stdout).

        Args:
            args: Git arguments, e.g. ``["checkout", "-b", "feature/x"]``.
            cwd: Working directory. Defaults to the repository root.
            strip_output: Strip leading/trailing whitespace from stdout. Set it
                to False for commands whose leading spaces carry meaning, such
                as ``git status --porcelain``.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'ok', 'command', 'output', 'error' and 'returncode'.
        """
        cwd = cwd or self._get_repo_root()
        command = ["git"] + list(args)
        command_str = " ".join(command)
        logger.info("git command: %s (cwd=%s)", command_str, cwd)
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                command, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True
            )
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.error("Error running '%s': %s", command_str, ex)
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "command": command_str,
                "output": "",
                "error": str(ex),
                "returncode": -1,
            }

        raw_output = completed.stdout or ""
        output = raw_output.strip() if strip_output else raw_output
        error = (completed.stderr or "").strip()
        ok = completed.returncode == 0
        if not ok:
            logger.warning("git command failed: %s. %s", command_str, error)
        return {
            "ok": ok,
            "command": command_str,
            "output": output,
            "error": error,
            "returncode": completed.returncode,
        }

    def _ref_exists(self, ref: str, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Check whether a git ref (branch, remote branch or commit) exists.

        Args:
            ref: Full ref name, e.g. ``refs/heads/main`` or ``origin/main``.
            cwd: Working directory. Defaults to the repository root.

        Returns:
            True when the ref can be resolved.
        """
        result = self._run_git(["rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref], cwd=cwd)
        return bool(result["ok"] and result["output"])

    def _resolve_base_ref(self, base_branch: Optional[str], cwd: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Resolve the ref a new PR branch should be created from.

        Local branches are preferred (PRs are reviewed locally) and the remote
        tracking branch is used as a fallback.

        Args:
            base_branch: Base branch name, may be empty.
            cwd: Working directory (repository root).

        Returns:
            Resolvable ref name, or None when the base branch is unknown.
        """
        if not base_branch:
            return None

        base_branch = self._sanitize_branch_name(base_branch)
        for candidate in (
            f"refs/heads/{base_branch}",
            f"refs/remotes/origin/{base_branch}",
        ):
            if self._ref_exists(candidate, cwd=cwd):
                return candidate

        logger.warning("Base branch not found: %s", base_branch)
        return None

    def _get_remote_url(self, remote: str = DEFAULT_REMOTE) -> str:
        """
        Return the configured URL for a remote.

        Args:
            remote: Remote name.

        Returns:
            Remote URL, or an empty string when the remote is not configured.
        """
        result = self._run_git(["config", "--get", f"remote.{remote}.url"])
        return result["output"] if result["ok"] else ""

    def _get_ahead_behind(
        self, branch: str, remote: str = DEFAULT_REMOTE
    ) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """
        Return how many commits the local branch is ahead/behind its remote.

        Args:
            branch: Local branch name.
            remote: Remote name.

        Returns:
            Tuple of ``(ahead, behind)``; ``(0, 0)`` when there is no upstream.
        """
        if not branch:
            return 0, 0

        upstream = f"{remote}/{branch}"
        if not self._ref_exists(f"refs/remotes/{upstream}"):
            return 0, 0

        result = self._run_git(
            ["rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", f"{upstream}...{branch}"]
        )
        if not result["ok"] or not result["output"]:
            return 0, 0

        try:
            behind, ahead = result["output"].split()
        except ValueError:
            return 0, 0
        return int(ahead), int(behind)

    def _ensure_local_branch(
        self, branch: str, remote: str = DEFAULT_REMOTE
    ) -> dict:
        """
        Make sure a branch exists locally, creating it from the remote if needed.

        Args:
            branch: Branch name.
            remote: Remote name.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'ok', 'created' and 'error'.
        """
        if self._ref_exists(f"refs/heads/{branch}"):
            return {"ok": True, "created": False, "error": ""}

        if self._ref_exists(f"refs/remotes/{remote}/{branch}"):
            result = self._run_git(
                ["checkout", "-b", branch, f"{remote}/{branch}"]
            )
            return {
                "ok": result["ok"],
                "created": result["ok"],
                "error": result["error"],
            }

        return {
            "ok": False,
            "created": False,
            "error": f"Branch '{branch}' does not exist",
        }

    def _git_operation_result(self, command_result: dict, **extra) -> dict:
        """
        Convert a ``_run_git`` result into an operation result dict.

        Failures caused by a stale index lock are flagged with 'locked' and
        'lock_path' so the caller can offer to release the lock.

        Args:
            command_result: Dict returned by ``_run_git``.
            extra: Additional fields merged into the result.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'success', 'command', 'output' and 'errors'.
        """
        ok = bool(command_result.get("ok"))
        error = command_result.get("error") or ""
        result = {
            "success": ok,
            "command": command_result.get("command", ""),
            "output": command_result.get("output", ""),
            "errors": [] if ok else [error or "git command failed"],
            **extra,
        }
        if not ok:
            result.update(self._lock_error_info(error))
        return result

    def _git_operation_error(self, message: str, **extra) -> dict:
        """
        Build a failed operation result dict.

        Args:
            message: Human readable error message.
            extra: Additional fields merged into the result.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'success' set to False and the message in 'errors'.
        """
        return {"success": False, "errors": [message], **extra}

    def _lock_error_info(self, error_text: str) -> dict:
        """
        Detect a stale index lock in a failed git command output.

        Git refuses to write the index while ``.git/index.lock`` exists and
        reports ``Unable to create '.../index.lock': File exists``. Such a
        failure is returned with 'locked' and 'lock_path' so the UI can offer to
        release the lock instead of showing an opaque git error.

        Args:
            error_text: Stderr of the failed git command.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'locked' and 'lock_path' when the command failed because
            of the index lock, an empty dict otherwise.
        """
        text = (error_text or "").lower()
        lock_blocked = "index.lock" in text and (
            "file exists" in text or "unable to create" in text
        )
        if not lock_blocked:
            return {}
        info = self.get_lock_info()
        return {"locked": True, "lock_path": info.get("path", "")}

    def _get_file_last_modification(self, file_path: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Return the last modification datetime of a file as an ISO 8601 string.
        """
        if not os.path.isabs(file_path):
            file_path = os.path.join(self.settings.abs_project_path, file_path)
        if not os.path.isfile(file_path):
            return None
        mtime = os.path.getmtime(file_path)
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime).isoformat()

    def _get_git_root_for_file(self, file_path: str) -> str:
        """
        Determine the Git root for a given file, allowing for subprojects.

        Args:
            file_path: The path to the file.

        Returns:
            The absolute Git root path.
        """
        if not os.path.isabs(file_path):
            file_path = os.path.join(self.settings.abs_project_path, file_path)
            
        current_path = os.path.dirname(file_path)
        
        while current_path != os.path.dirname(current_path):
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(current_path, '.git')):
                return current_path
            current_path = os.path.dirname(current_path)
            
        return self.find_git_root_path()

    def _write_repo_file(self, repo_path: str, file_path: str, content: str) -> dict:
        """
        Write a file inside a repository (or worktree), creating parent folders.

        Paths escaping the repository root are rejected.

        Args:
            repo_path: Absolute repository (or worktree) root.
            file_path: Relative (to the repo) or absolute file path.
            content: Full file content to write.

        Returns:
            Dict with 'ok', 'file_path' (repo-relative) and 'error'.
        """
        repo_root = os.path.normpath(repo_path)
        resolved = file_path
        if not os.path.isabs(resolved):
            resolved = os.path.join(repo_root, resolved)
        resolved = os.path.normpath(resolved)

        if not resolved.startswith(repo_root + os.sep):
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "file_path": file_path,
                "error": f"File path must belong to {repo_path}",
            }

        try:
            dir_name = os.path.dirname(resolved)
            if dir_name:
                os.makedirs(dir_name, exist_ok=True)
            with open(resolved, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(content if content is not None else "")
        except (IOError, OSError) as ex:
            logger.error("Error writing file %s: %s", resolved, ex)
            return {"ok": False, "file_path": file_path, "error": str(ex)}

        return {
            "ok": True,
            "file_path": os.path.relpath(resolved, repo_root),
            "error": "",
        }

    def diff_file(self, path: str, content: str, from_branch: str = None, to_branch: str = None) -> dict:
        """
        Diff a project file against provided content using git diff --no-index.
        Optionally compare against specific branches.

        Args:
            path: File path.
            content: New content to diff against.
            from_branch: Optional source branch for comparison (git diff --no-index ignores this for file diffs).
            to_branch: Optional target branch for comparison (git diff --no-index ignores this for file diffs).

        Returns:
            Dict with 'diff', 'stats', 'last_modification', and 'size'.
        
        Note:
            For branch-based diffs, use git commands like:
            `git diff from_branch to_branch -- path` instead of `git diff --no-index`.
            This implementation uses --no-index for comparing working tree against provided content.
        """
        path = self._get_git_root_for_file(file_path=path)

        # For comparing against branches, we would use different git commands
        # Currently using --no-index for comparing working file against new content
        if from_branch and to_branch:
            # Compare file between two branches
            cmd = ["git", "diff", f"{from_branch}..{to_branch}", "--", path]
            result = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
            diff_out = result.stdout
            
            git_stats_cmd = ["git", "diff", f"{from_branch}..{to_branch}", "--shortstat", "--", path]
            stats_result = subprocess.run(git_stats_cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
            diff_stats_out = stats_result.stdout
        else:
            # Default behavior: compare provided content against current file
            cmd = ["git", "diff", "--no-index", path, "-"]
            result = subprocess.run(cmd, input=content, text=True, capture_output=True)
            diff_out = result.stdout

            git_command = f"""
            cat << EOF | git --no-pager diff --shortstat --no-index -- - {path}
            {content}
            EOF
            """
            diff_stats_out = os.popen(git_command).read()

        return {
            "diff": diff_out.strip(),
            "stats": diff_stats_out.strip(),
        }

    def get_repo_branches(self) -> list:
        """
        Return all git branches (local and remote) for the project.
        Sanitizes branch names by removing prefixes.
        """
        def get_branches(cmd: str) -> list:
            stdout, _ = exec_command(cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
            branches = [s.strip() for s in stdout.split("\n") if s.strip()]
            return [self._sanitize_branch_name(b) for b in branches]

        branches = list(set(get_branches("git branch") + get_branches("git branch -r")))
        branches.sort()
        return branches

    def get_project_branches(self) -> dict:
        """
        Return branches and full repo tree.
        """
        return {
            "branches": self.get_repo_branches(),
            "repo_tree": self.get_repo_tree(),
        }

    def get_project_branch_commits(self, branch: str) -> dict:
        """
        Return commits for a given branch.
        """
        branch = self._sanitize_branch_name(branch)
        commits, _ = exec_command(
            f"git log {branch}", cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path
        )
        return {"commits": commits}

    def find_git_root_path(self) -> str:
        """
        Find the root path of the git repository by checking parents.
        """
        if self.settings.is_git_root:
            return self.settings.abs_project_path
        for parent in find_project_parents(project=self.settings):
            if parent.is_git_root:
                return parent.abs_project_path
        return ""

    def get_commit_list(self, branch: str = None, limit: int = 50) -> list:
        """
        Return a structured list of commits for a branch or HEAD.

        Args:
            branch: Branch name. Defaults to current HEAD.
            limit:  Maximum number of commits to return.

        Returns:
            List of commit dicts with hash, author, date, message.
        """
        if branch:
            branch = self._sanitize_branch_name(branch)
        
        ref = branch or "HEAD"
        pretty = "%H|%an|%ae|%ad|%s"
        cmd = f"git log --pretty=format:{pretty} --date=iso -n {limit} {ref}"
        stdout, _ = exec_command(cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)

        commits = []
        for line in stdout.strip().split("\n"):
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            try:
                commit_hash, author_name, author_email, date, message = line.split("|", 4)
                commits.append({
                    "commit": commit_hash,
                    "short_commit": commit_hash[:8],
                    "author": {"name": author_name, "email": author_email},
                    "date": date.strip(),
                    "message": message.strip(),
                    "label": f"{commit_hash[:8]} - {message.strip()[:60]}"
                })
            except ValueError:
                logger.warning("Could not parse commit line: %s", line)
        return commits

    def get_commit_changes(self, from_commit: str, to_commit: str) -> dict:
        """
        Return file changes and diffs between two commits.

        Args:
            from_commit: Source commit hash (newer).
            to_commit:   Target commit hash (older / base).

        Returns:
            Dict matching the shape of get_repo_changes output.
        """
        diff_name_cmd = f"git diff --name-only {to_commit}...{from_commit}"
        branch_files_raw, _ = exec_command(diff_name_cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
        branch_files = [f for f in branch_files_raw.strip().split("\n") if f]

        def get_file_diff(file_path: str) -> str:
            cmd = f"git diff {to_commit}...{from_commit} -- {file_path}"
            out, _ = exec_command(cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
            return out.strip()

        def get_file_commits(file_path: str) -> list:
            pretty = '{ "commit": "%H", "author": "%an", "date": "%as", "message": "%f" }'
            cmd = f"git log --pretty=format:'{pretty}' {to_commit}..{from_commit} -- {file_path}"
            out, _ = exec_command(cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
            results = []
            for line in out.strip().split("\n"):
                try:
                    results.append(json.loads(line))
                except Exception:
                    pass
            return results

        branch_file_and_commits = {
            file_path: {
                "commits": get_file_commits(file_path),
                "diff": get_file_diff(file_path),
                "last_modification": self._get_file_last_modification(file_path),
            }
            for file_path in branch_files
        }

        git_diff_cmd = f"git diff {to_commit} {from_commit}"
        git_diff_out, _ = exec_command(git_diff_cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
        git_diff_stat_out, _ = exec_command(
            f"git diff --shortstat {to_commit} {from_commit}",
            cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path
        )

        pr_details = self.get_pr_review_details_by_commits(from_commit, to_commit)

        return {
            "diff": git_diff_out,
            "stat": git_diff_stat_out,
            "git_diff_cmd": git_diff_cmd,
            "local_changes": {},
            "repo_path": self.find_git_root_path(),
            "pr_details": pr_details,
            "commits": [],
            "branch_file_and_commits": branch_file_and_commits,
            "compare_type": "commit",
            "from_commit": from_commit,
            "to_commit": to_commit,
        }

    def get_pr_review_details_by_commits(self, from_commit: str, to_commit: str) -> list:
        """
        Return PR review details between two commits.

        Args:
            from_commit: Source commit hash.
            to_commit:   Target / base commit hash.

        Returns:
            List of change dicts per file.
        """
        diff_command = f"git diff --name-status {to_commit}..{from_commit}"
        stdout, _ = exec_command(diff_command, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)

        STATUS_MAP = {"A": "new", "D": "deleted"}
        changes = []

        for line in stdout.strip().split("\n"):
            # Guard: skip empty lines or lines without a tab separator
            if not line or "\t" not in line:
                continue
            parts = line.split("\t", 1)
            if len(parts) < 2:
                continue
            status, file_path = parts
            file_path = file_path.strip()
            if not file_path:
                continue

            file_status = STATUS_MAP.get(status.strip(), "modified")

            file_diff, _ = exec_command(
                f"git diff {to_commit}..{from_commit} -- {file_path}",
                cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path
            )
            file_commits_raw, _ = exec_command(
                f"git log --oneline {to_commit}..{from_commit} -- {file_path}",
                cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path
            )
            changes.append({
                "file_name": file_path,
                "status": file_status,
                "diff": file_diff,
                "commits": [c for c in file_commits_raw.strip().split("\n") if c],
                "last_modification": self._get_file_last_modification(file_path),
            })

        return changes

            """Get commits that touched a specific file between branches."""

            cmd = f"git log --pretty=format:'{pretty}' {to_branch}..{from_branch} -- {file_path}"
            git_cmd_out, _ = exec_command(cmd, cwd=self.settings.abs_project_path)
